messages:
emma-sales: heads up — LucidaHealth wants to run a 2-week POC with Lucida-13B-v2. They're dealing with PHI so they asked: 1) which model variants we can serve in Hosted/Dedicated/Private, 2) KMS + audit log support, 3) latency SLOs for 1k token prompts, and 4) a quick delta in pricing between Hosted and Dedicated. Can ML/infra/Legal chime in?

ben-ml: quick summary — we onboarded lucida-13b (fp16) and a GPTQ-derived lucida-13b-8bit. Both variants are in the catalog but compatibility differs: Hosted -> fp16 only right now; Dedicated & Private -> both (8-bit requires updated kernel path + different kv-cache layout). 8-bit has ~10-15% perf/accuracy drift on some head tasks, recommend eval set.

ryan-enginfra: infra notes — for Dedicated 8-bit we run on A100s with our quantized kernels. Expected p95 latency for 1k tokens w/ batching disabled: ~150-250ms depending on batch size and seq len. Hosted fp16 p95 is typically ~120-180ms. If customer needs <100ms we should consider smaller sequence windows or autoscale bursts.

maria-se: pricing quickballpark — Hosted: pay-as-you-go per-token + request overhead; Dedicated: monthly reserved GPU pool. For a small POC (single A100 equivalent pool) estimate ~ $Xk/mo committed vs hosted variable; I'll pull exact numbers and DM.

emma-sales: they also asked about KMS + key deletion policy and whether we can produce audit logs showing who accessed model predictions. @olivia-legal can we answer SSQ Q12/Q23?

olivia-legal: short answers — Private: supports customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own) + full audit logs retained per contract. Dedicated: we can integrate with customer KMS for private deployments; for Redwood-hosted Dedicated offering we currently use managed keys but can negotiate. Hosted API: no customer-managed KMS yet; we provide SOC2 + encryption at rest/in transit. For SSQ Q12 (data residency) — we can commit to region X for Private/Dedicated; Hosted can be pinned to region(s) depending on availability.

ben-ml: accuracy note — 8-bit quantization reduces memory and inference cost but can affect tail-case answers. Recommend we run a 1k-sample eval (customer-provided prompt set) against both variants. We can deliver eval report in ~24 hours once data is uploaded.

maria-se: operational ask — we'll need the customer's expected qps, avg prompt length, and any SLOs for cold-starts. Also confirm whether they want canary/fallback routing to fp16 Hosted if Dedicated capacity is saturated. Example fallback route config I usually share:

```json
{ "routes": [ { "priority": 1, "target": "private/lucida-13b-8bit", "conditions": { "region": "us-west-2" } }, { "priority": 2, "target": "dedicated/lucida-13b", "conditions": {} }, { "priority": 3, "target": "hosted/lucida-13b", "conditions": { "max_latency_ms": 400 } } ] }
```

emma-sales: perfect — I'll ask them for the eval prompt set + qps numbers. Can we also confirm whether audit logs include request-level payloads or only metadata?

olivia-legal: audit logs can be configured to include request metadata and redacted payloads. For PHI-heavy workloads we recommend Private with contractual logging terms and a data processing addendum.

ryan-enginfra: one more infra caveat — if they want on-prem, we need to schedule an environment checklist: GPU type, network egress rules, and KMS endpoint config. I can share the checklist doc after this thread.

maria-se: scheduling — propose a 30-min deep-dive tomorrow with Sales + ML + Infra + Legal. I'll send an invite.

emma-sales: thanks all — tagging next steps: 1) I'll get eval prompts + qps, 2) @maria-se will send pricing numbers, 3) @ben-ml will run the eval once we have prompts, 4) @ryan-enginfra will share the infra checklist, 5) @olivia-legal will draft SSQ responses. :thumbsup:

ben-ml: noted. I'll queue eval jobs once data's in.

ryan-enginfra: I'll drop the checklist and an ops runbook after standup.

maria-se: invite sent.

emma-sales: closing loop here — appreciate the quick turn.
